summary: Restructure all Spelling Bee wheels into the official 10-wheel competition system: 3 general round wheels (1st-3rd, 4th-6th, and High School) with 40s timers, plus 7 cumulative tiebreak wheels (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th grades and High School) combining general words with grade tiebreak vocabulary and 20s timers. Updates UI buttons to display 'General' and 'Tiebreak'.
